lesson_title: Where in South Africa Are You?
hook_text: Nine letters arrive from nine provinces. Each one starts by saying exactly where its writer lives.
clip_script: Mahikeng. A pen-pal box full of letters. I live in Thohoyandou, in Limpopo, north-east of Polokwane. I live in Upington, in the Northern Cape, on the Orange River. I live in Durban, in KwaZulu-Natal, on the Indian Ocean. Each writer names their settlement, their province, the nearest big city and a direction. Can you do the same? Find your town on the map, name your province, and say which way you are from the capital.
visual_style: Whiteboard map of South Africa with letters flying in from each province and landing as dots, each dot linked to its capital by a short arrow.
mood: Friendly and connected, like getting post from all over the country.
pacing: One letter per province, a dot on the map, then the learner's own address.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and describe where your own settlement is in one sentence.
